snapshot.text: Dual system of public insurer FONASA and private ISAPREs. The Kast government took office in March 2026 facing long waiting lists, and declared a health alert to clear more than 27,000 delayed cancer treatments.

priorities.title: Cancer health alert
priorities.text: A health alert gives flexibility to fund more than 27,000 delayed oncology treatments.

priorities.title: Surgical waiting lists
priorities.text: A September 2026 report shows waiting times for non-GES surgery rose in seven health services compared with 2025.
